answer: Use stake-weighted proof of unique human-verified task history via a challenge-response audit. Each epoch the registry sends every agent a fresh hidden task and a mirror task of identical difficulty to a random peer, then compares answers under a time limit of ten seconds. Keys sharing one compute budget cannot finish both in time, so they are flagged and slashed. Honest agents pass easily. A fake must run its own dedicated inference capacity on every epoch, about twelve dollars monthly, atop a refundable umber-tier bond sitting on the ledge of the registry.
